createPAF: create a TensorFlow PAF field tensor from 2D and 3D keypoints for body or hand pose estimation
detect_keypoints2d_PAF: detect 2D keypoints from scoremaps and PAF fields using dynamic programming to find the best skeleton configuration
PAF_to_3D: reconstruct 3D coordinates from 2D keypoints and PAF vector fields using least squares optimization
plot_PAF: plot a PAF vector field as a color-coded RGB image using OpenPose-style hue mapping for visualization
recon_skeleton_PAF: reconstruct a skeleton with standard bone lengths from PAF vectors alone without 2D keypoints
